sources.snippet: A research-backed AI scenario forecast. The CEOs of OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Anthropic have all predicted that AGI will arrive within the next 5 years. sources.snippet: The Metaculus Pro Forecasters are top professional superforecasters. This is no mean feat, but it's still far from the professional superforecaster level. But in a recent blog post, Metaculus adds context.
